source_span: Ultimately, we would buy this dip through the broadening trade: yields are moving towards fair value (5.5%), similar episodes have historically been buying opportunities, equity valuations offer a cushion
source_chain: PMI beats and capex strength push yields toward JPM's 5.5% fair-value estimate, therefore JPM buys the equity dip now through the broadening trade (with equity valuation cushion and possible geopolitical de-escalation as further support), even while holding a tactically cautious near-term stance for other stated reasons (yield pressure, debt-sustainability context) -- no invalidation is given because the buy call is active immediately, not gated on a yield level.
pulse_chain: JPM's 5.5% fair value sits more than 30bp above the current 5.11% ten-year yield, therefore JPM 'needs more yield pain before its buy level arrives,' therefore its near-term equity stance stays cautious until that threshold is reached -- invalidation is implicitly yields rising to 5.5%.
why: The note has JPM already buying the dip now, using the move toward 5.5% as one of several supporting reasons rather than a precondition, but the pulse inverts this into a deferred, threshold-gated buy call ('needs more yield pain before its buy level arrives') that the note never states.
